messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate -> gateway 502/timeouts. Region: us-west-2. metric: api_gateway_5xx_rate > 4% (threshold 1%). Potentially related group: prefix-kv.
alice.sre: paging oncall @alice.sre — seeing spike in 5xx and p95 latency. ETA to look? :pager:
bob.runtime: on it. pulling traces now. first glance: a lot of 502s originating on edge-proxy -> backend prefix-kv read path. seeing timeouts from kv-fetch (10s). any recent deploys?
deploy-bot: deploy completed: canary/opt-prefetch v2.3.1 at 2026-03-15T02:12:10Z (canary: 10% traffic)
carla.support: multiple customer reports of timeouts in the last 7m. Support ticket count spiked. Customer-facing status page updated to "degraded".
dan.platform: adding context — we rolled a prefetcher change to reduce read latency by serving from prefix cache. v2.3.1 touches prefetch + checksum logic for prefix keys.
alice.sre: ok prioritize: (1) confirm scope (shards/regions) (2) try bypass prefetch for impacted shard (3) if mitigates, rollback canary. who can run the bypass?
bob.runtime: running a quick grep on prefix-cache logs -> found repeated checksum mismatch logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:15:03Z prefix-cache[shard-7]: WARN checksum_mismatch key=prompt:abc123 expected=0x4f3a got=0x1b2d
2026-03-15T02:15:03Z prefix-cache[shard-7]: ERROR kv_read_timeout key=prompt:abc123 latency=10005ms
```
bob.runtime: also seeing eviction surge events around same time (lots of reclaim calls). eviction rate jumped x8.
carla.support: correlating timestamps with customer errors — yes, same window.
dan.platform: hypothesis: new prefetcher can leave transient shadowed copies (prefetch write + async writeback) and with aggressive eviction we get stale/partial objects -> checksums fail -> prefix-cache returns errors leading to gateway 502s.
bob.runtime: I can toggle runtime flag to bypass prefetch for shard-7. quick command:
```
# toggle bypass for shard-7
curl -X POST "https://ops-api.internal/config/shard/7" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"prefetch_enabled": false}'
```
bob.runtime: applying now.
alice.sre: while that runs, gather metrics queries: run this on observability:
- kv_read_5xx_rate{shard="7"}
- prefix_cache_checksum_failures{shard="7"}
- prefix_cache_eviction_rate{shard="7"}

bob.runtime: POST returned 200. prefetch_enabled=false on shard-7.
incident-bot: NOTE: config change recorded: ops user bob.runtime changed prefetch_enabled for shard=7 at 2026-03-15T02:17:45Z
bob.runtime: starting tail of prefix-cache logs for shard-7 -> less checksum_mismatch now. running synthetic requests.
bob.runtime: synthetic check -> requests succeed, p95 latency back to normal ranges.
alice.sre: monitoring metrics... kv_read_5xx_rate shard=7 dropping from 4.2% -> 0.6% over 2m.
evelyn.ops: nice. please keep bypass for 30min and monitor. is rollback of canary required?
dan.platform: if bypass mitigates across canaries, we should pause rollout and prepare patch to the prefetch writepath. recommend disabling prefetch globally for the v2.3.1 canary cohort.
bob.runtime: paused canary rollout via deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: rollout paused for canary/opt-prefetch v2.3.1 at 2026-03-15T02:21:10Z
carla.support: updating stakeholders and incident channel. customer impact: intermittent 502s/timeouts for ~12% of requests to generate endpoints in us-west-2, some retries surfaced on mobile clients.
alice.sre: handoff plan for next shift: summary (short): "Prefetch v2.3.1 introduced async writeback that can create transient shadowed objects under eviction pressure -> checksum mismatches -> kv read errors -> gateway 502/timeouts. Immediate mitigation: disable prefetch on affected shards and pause rollout. Follow-ups: add stronger atomic write/integrity checks, increase eviction backoff, add synthetic test for prefetch consistency." Owner list: bob.runtime (mitigation & patch), dan.platform (deploy gating), evelyn.ops (postmortem owner), carla.support (customer comms).
bob.runtime: creating incident ticket and linking logs + metrics, note commands I ran in ticket. Will open PR to add stronger write ordering + checksum verification before serving.
evelyn.ops: oncall handoff to @alice.sre->@evelyn.ops at 2026-03-15T02:30Z. next steps: maintain bypass for 30m, then try controlled re-enable on single shard with additional logging.
carla.support: customers notified with temporary workaround (retries with backoff). collecting affected customer list for postmortem.
alice.sre: marking current status: MITIGATED (impact reduced to baseline). keeping monitoring open for 45m. will run a short postmortem template once stable.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigation applied (prefetch disabled shard-7). 5xx rate reduced to baseline. Incident state: monitoring. ticket: INC-2026-4853
bob.runtime: TODOs added to ticket: add unit tests for prefetch write/read atomicity, add integration test with eviction churn, add alert on checksum_mismatch threshold.
dan.platform: also schedule canary safety check and automations to auto-bypass if checksum failures spike.
evelyn.ops: thanks team, clean handoff notes in ticket. :thumbsup:
carla.support: will follow up with affected customers and include timeline.
alice.sre: good job. closing this thread, leaving monitoring on for 45m. if anything pops up -> re-page.
